minor.issue: Preface body_md is only 1,507 chars. This matches Gutenberg #130 source (the Preface is genuinely short — ~250 words), so it is NOT a truncation bug. Flagging only because the main agent's spec asked for `>5000 chars on ch0`; the >5000 threshold is realistic for chapters 1-9 but not for the Preface itself. Test was adjusted to assert ch0>1000 chars + ch1>5000 chars to reflect actual source structure. No code fix needed.

rca_of_issue: Original user bugs: (A) Bernadette film played only a 3-minute trailer, (B) book reader didn't render full chapter text for the Catholic classics. RCA-A: ccc-bernadette-anim's previously seeded youtube_id pointed to a short trailer/clip rather than a full feature; iter-36 swapped to ACBWU4ug-rc (a full-length Bernadette/Lourdes film, oEmbed-confirmed live). RCA-B: orthodoxy-chesterton was still type='external' with no embedded chapters, and the chapter response shape did not surface a subtitle field; iter-36 flipped it to type='embedded', ran scripts/load_full_books.py parse_orthodoxy on Gutenberg #130 to ingest 10 chapters / ~63K words, added subtitle to GET /api/library/books/{slug}/chapters/{idx}, and on the frontend split body_md on blank-line boundaries into multiple <Text> nodes so very large chapters (Confessions Bk X ~86K chars, Orthodoxy Ch VII ~51K chars) don't choke the RN text engine. Backend end-to-end retest in this iteration confirms all fixes.
